messages.author: 8a9dc1e734eac985
messages.subject: how to build starting parameters
parts:
Hi,
I store the item parameters in a simple table of:  item, a1, d
Could you direct me to an example how to build the starting parameters for mirt from this table to speed up estimation of these parameters from a new (larger) dataset?
Many thanks
Balázs

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: how to build starting parameters
parts:
library(mirt)

a <- rlnorm(20, .2, .2)
d <- rnorm(20)
dat <- simdata(a, d, N = 10000, itemtype='2PL')

mod <- mirt(dat[1:5000,], 1)
coef(mod, simplify=TRUE)
sv <- mod2values(mod)
head(sv)

mod2 <- mirt(dat, 1, pars = sv)
coef(mod2, simplify=TRUE)

Phil

Many thanks for your help.
Balázs
